description_en: Queries the extension point data snapshot at the time an extension point event was triggered, based on the message ID of a DataWorks open message
description_zh: 根据DataWorks开放消息的消息ID，查询触发扩展点事件时的扩展点数据快照
name: GetIDEEventDetail

parameters.help_en:
The message ID of the DataWorks open message. After an extension point event is triggered, you can obtain the message ID from the received event message.

<props="china">For the message format, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215367.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks开放消息的消息ID。当触发扩展点事件后，您可以从接收到的事件消息中获取消息ID。

<props="china">消息格式，可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/215367.html。</props>
parameters.name: message_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can obtain the workspace ID by parsing the DataWorks open message
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以通过解析DataWorks开放消息获取空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

EventDetail.description_en:
The data snapshot at the time the extension point event was triggered.

Different types of message events have different valid fields in the data snapshot. For details, refer to the field descriptions of each message event
EventDetail.description_zh:
触发扩展点事件时的数据快照。

不同类型的消息事件，数据快照的有效字段存在差异，具体请参考各消息事件的字段说明

CommittedFile.description_en:
The snapshot when a file is committed or deployed.

This field is valid only when the Message type is IDE_FILE_SUBMIT_BEFORE or IDE_FILE_DEPLOY_BEFORE
CommittedFile.description_zh:
文件提交和发布时的快照。

仅当Message类型为IDE_FILE_SUBMIT_BEFORE或IDE_FILE_DEPLOY_BEFORE时有效

ChangeType.description_en: The change type of this file version. Valid values: CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE
ChangeType.description_zh: 本次文件版本的变更类型，包括CREATE、UPDATE和DELETE

Comment.description_en: The description of this file version

Committor.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud user ID that generated this file version
Committor.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的阿里云用户ID

Content.description_en: The file code that generated this file version
Content.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的文件代码

FilePropertyContent.description_en: The additional properties of the file

BusinessId.description_en: The ID of the workflow to which the file belongs

CurrentVersion.description_en: The latest version of the file

DataSourceName.description_en: The unique identifier of the data source associated with the file
DataSourceName.description_zh: 文件关联的数据源唯一标识

FolderId.description_en: The ID of the folder to which the file belongs. You can call the [GetFolder]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173952.html） operation to query file details by folder ID
FolderId.description_zh: 文件所属的文件夹ID，您可以调用[GetFolder]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173952.html）接口，通过文件夹ID查询文件详情

ParentFileId.description_en: The node ID of the loop node or traversal node to which the file belongs
ParentFileId.description_zh: 文件所属的循环节点或遍历节点的节点ID

FileType.description_en: The file type. Different file types have different code. For more information, see [DataWorks nodes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html）
FileType.description_zh: 文件类型。不同文件类型其代码不同，详情请参见[DataWorks节点合集]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/600169.html）

NodeConfiguration.description_en: The scheduling configuration of the file

AutoRerunIntervalMillis.description_en: The interval between automatic reruns, in milliseconds

CycleType.description_en:
The type of the scheduling cycle. Valid values: NOT_DAY (minute or hour) and DAY (day, week, or month).

This parameter corresponds to the "Schedule Configuration > Time Properties > Scheduling Cycle" setting of a DataStudio task in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
CycleType.description_zh:
调度周期的类型，包括NOT_DAY（分钟、小时）和DAY（日、周、月）。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>时间属性>调度周期”对应

DependentNodeIdList.description_en:
The IDs of the nodes on which the current file depends when the DependentType parameter settings are set to USER_DEFINE. Separate multiple node IDs with commas (,).

This parameter corresponds to the "Settings > Scheduling Dependencies > Cross-epoch Dependencies (Previous Epoch)" setting of a DataStudio task in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console), when the dependency is set to "Other Nodes"
DependentNodeIdList.description_zh:
当DependentType参数配置为USER_DEFINE时，用于设置当前文件具体依赖的节点ID。依赖多个节点时，使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖>跨周期依赖（原上一周期）”，依赖项选择”其他节点“时配置的内容对应

DependentType.description_en:
The method of depending on the previous cycle. Valid values:
SELF: the dependency is set to the current node.
CHILD: the dependency is set to first-level child nodes.
USER_DEFINE: the dependency is set to other nodes.
NONE: no dependency is selected, meaning the node does not depend on the previous cycle
DependentType.description_zh:
依赖上一周期的方式。取值如下：
SELF：依赖项选择本节点。
CHILD：依赖项选择一级子节点。
USER_DEFINE：依赖项选择其他节点。
NONE：未选择依赖项，即不会依赖上一周期

InputList.description_en: The upstream file outputs on which the file depends
InputList.description_zh: 文件依赖的上游文件输出

items.description_en: The information about the upstream file output on which the file depends
items.description_zh: 依赖的上游文件输出信息

Input.description_en:
The output name of the upstream file on which the file depends.

This parameter corresponds to the "Output Name of Upstream Node" in the "Schedule Configuration > Scheduling Dependencies > Depends On Upstream Nodes" setting of a DataStudio task in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
Input.description_zh:
文件依赖的上游文件的输出名称。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖>依赖上游节点“的”上游节点输出名”对应

ParseType.description_en:
The method used to configure file dependencies. Valid values:
MANUAL: manual configuration.
AUTO: automatic parsing
ParseType.description_zh:
配置文件依赖的方式，取值如下：
MANUAL：手动配置。
AUTO：自动解析

OutputList.description_en:
The outputs of the file.

This parameter corresponds to the "Schedule Configuration > Scheduling Dependencies > Output Name of Current Node" setting of a DataStudio task in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
OutputList.description_zh:
文件的输出。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖>本节点输出名称“对应

items.description_en: The output information of the file

Output.description_en:
The output name of the file.

This parameter corresponds to the "Output Name" in the "Schedule Configuration > Scheduling Dependencies > Output Name of Current Node" setting of a DataStudio task in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
Output.description_zh:
文件的输出名称。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖>本节点输出名称“的“输出名”对应

RefTableName.description_en:
The output table name of the file.

This parameter corresponds to the "Output Table Name" in the "Schedule Configuration > Scheduling Dependencies > Output Name of Current Node" setting of a DataStudio task in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
RefTableName.description_zh:
文件的输出表名。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>调度依赖>本节点输出名称“的“输出表名”对应

ParaValue.description_en:
The scheduling parameters.

This parameter corresponds to the "Schedule Configuration > Parameters" setting of a DataStudio task in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console). For more information, see [Scheduling parameters]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137548.html）
ParaValue.description_zh:
调度参数。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>参数”对应。您可以参考[调度参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/137548.html）配置

RerunMode.description_en:
The rerun property. Valid values:
ALL_ALLOWED: The node can be rerun regardless of whether it runs successfully or fails.
FAILURE_ALLOWED: The node can be rerun only after it fails.
ALL_DENIED: The node cannot be rerun regardless of whether it runs successfully or fails.

This parameter corresponds to the "Schedule Configuration > Time Properties > Rerun Properties" setting of a DataStudio task in the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)
RerunMode.description_zh:
重跑属性。取值如下：
ALL_ALLOWED：运行成功或失败后皆可重跑。
FAILURE_ALLOWED：运行成功后不可重跑，运行失败后可以重跑。
ALL_DENIED：运行成功或失败皆不可重跑。

该参数与DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)中，数据开发任务的“调度配置>时间属性>重跑属性”配置内容对应

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The resource group used when the task is executed after the file is deployed. You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html） operation to obtain the list of available resource groups for the workspace
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 文件发布成任务后，任务执行时使用的资源组。您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html）获取工作空间可用的资源组列表

SchedulerType.description_en:
The scheduling type. Valid values:
NORMAL: normal scheduling task.
MANUAL: manual task that is not scheduled on a regular basis. This corresponds to nodes in a manual workflow.
PAUSE: paused task.
SKIP: dry-run task that is scheduled on a regular basis but is directly set to successful when scheduling starts
SchedulerType.description_zh:
调度的类型，取值如下：
NORMAL：正常调度任务。
MANUAL：手动任务，不会被日常调度，对应手动业务流程下的节点。
PAUSE：暂停任务。
SKIP：空跑任务，被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the scheduling node

UseType.description_en:
The functional module to which the file belongs. Valid values:
NORMAL: DataStudio.
MANUAL: manual task.
MANUAL_BIZ: manual workflow.
SKIP: dry-run scheduling in DataStudio.
ADHOCQUERY: ad hoc query.
COMPONENT: component management
UseType.description_zh:
文件所属的功能模块。取值如下：
NORMAL：数据开发
MANUAL：手动任务
MANUAL_BIZ：手动业务流程
SKIP：数据开发的空跑调度
ADHOCQUERY：临时查询
COMPONENT：组件管理

Indicates whether the column is a partition column. Valid values:
true: The column is a partition column.
false: The column is not a partition column

true：是分区字段。
false：非分区字段

DataSourceName.description_zh: 表所属数据源的唯一标识
